decisions.reason: Finned tubes remain a useful fit with the firm's air-cooler, spare-parts and service activities, but as a more standardized component line they face a moderate rationalization risk if management tightens focus on higher-value system offerings.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes fit the firm's R&D-driven efficiency positioning and can strengthen multiple exchanger applications, so management would be inclined to retain them unless they are clearly superseded by newer developments.
